content.short: Prividium is an institutional-grade, private L2 framework built on ZKsync for secure and compliant finance and assets.
content.description: Prividium is a pioneering blockchain framework developed by ZKsync, designed to provide financial institutions with the privacy and compliance needed for professional-grade digital asset management. By utilizing the ZK Stack, the platform allows organizations to operate private, permissioned Layer 2 networks where sensitive transaction data stays completely off-chain. This ensures institutional confidentiality while anchoring security to the Ethereum mainnet via zero-knowledge proofs. Featuring advanced identity management, Prividium acts as a secure bridge between traditional banking and DeFi.
content.meta: Prividium provides private, permissioned Layer 2 blockchain infrastructure for institutional compliance. Discover Prividium on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
